mapper.sql: id, email, password_hash, handle, display_name, bio, avatar_key, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (email, password_hash, handle, display_name) VALUES (#{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{handle}, #{displayName})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email}) )
SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE lower(handle) = lower(#{handle}) )
SELECT FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower(#{email})
SELECT FROM users WHERE lower(handle) = lower(#{handle})

SELECT u.id, u.handle, u.display_name, u.bio, u.avatar_key FROM users u WHERE u.handle ILIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR u.display_name ILIKE #{containsPattern} ESCAPE '\' ORDER BY (u.handle ILIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\' OR u.display_name ILIKE #{prefixPattern} ESCAPE '\') DESC, u.handle LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
